metadata.challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Flame in Freefall
metadata.evidence_policy: Partial-gravity (0.16g Lunar, 0.38g Martian) results must always be labeled as theoretical bounds/interpolations because NASA PSI currently contains no direct partial-gravity combustion datasets.

metrics.stability_regime: Sub-unity Lewis number (Le < 1): preferential mass diffusion intensifies curved microgravity flame fronts

example_response.summary_text: At 1200 K and 101.325 kPa, the lean CH4/O2/N2 mixture exhibits Le = 0.944, enabling thermo-diffusive focusing in buoyancy-free spherical flames.
